diagram_previews.alt: A large circle containing two equal circles that touch each other at its centre and touch it, and a small circle above them, marked with a question mark, touching all three. A radius of the large circle is labelled 2 and a radius of a medium circle is labelled 1.

A large circle with centre O containing two equal circles with centres O1 and O2 that touch each other at O and touch the large circle, and a small circle above them with centre P touching all three. Blue segments form the right triangle O O2 P with the right angle at O; a dashed segment continues from P to the point T where the small circle touches the large one.
The right triangle O O2 P drawn on its own, with the right angle at O, leg OO2 labelled 1, leg OP labelled 2 - r and hypotenuse O2P labelled 1 + r.
